content.text:
<task>
Production incident investigation across several services. Evidence arrives in
10 hourly rounds. Only round 1 is available now, under /task/fixtures/round-01/.

Each round directory holds:
- logs/<service>.log: that hour's structured service logs (the log format may change).
- board.md: the incident board's updates during that hour. An update lists only what
  changed; anything it does not mention is unchanged. The latest update for a thread wins.
- changes.md (some rounds): change records. APPLIED changes took effect; PROPOSED did not.

Reply {"action": "advance"} to release the next round. Released rounds never change and stay
readable. A final answer is accepted only after all 10 rounds are released.

Final answer (all fields required):
  {"action": "final", "answer": {
     "incidents": [{"cause": "<CAUSE_CODE>", "services": ["<service>", ...],
                    "status": "ongoing|mitigated|resolved",
                    "evidence_refs": ["round-NN/<file>:<line>", ...]}, ...],
     "unresolved": ["<FOLLOW_UP_CODE>", ...],
     "summary": "<short free text>"}}
- incidents: every real incident at the end of the final round (not false alarms), one entry
  per incident, with its current cause, all affected services and its current status.
- evidence_refs: path:line references (relative to /task/fixtures, ranges up to 20 lines as
  path:a-b) supporting the incident's current cause and current status; when the cause traces
  back to an earlier change record, cite that record too.
- unresolved: follow-up items still open at the end of the final round.

Cause codes:
  DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED: database connection pool exhausted
  CACHE_STAMPEDE: cache miss storm after mass expiry
  CERT_EXPIRED: an expired TLS certificate on a dependency
  DNS_RESOLUTION: DNS lookups failing for a dependency
  QUEUE_BACKLOG: message consumer lag growing
  MEMORY_LEAK: process memory growing until restarts
  UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT: an upstream provider rejecting requests with 429
  DISK_PRESSURE: a data volume running out of space
  BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT: a configuration value shipped by a rollout is invalid
Follow-up codes:
  CUSTOMER_COMMS: customer communication about the impact
  DATA_BACKFILL: backfill of records missed during the incident
  CAPACITY_REVIEW: capacity review of the affected tier
  ALERT_TUNING: tuning of noisy or late alerts
  VENDOR_TICKET: a ticket open with an external vendor
  POSTMORTEM_DRAFT: drafting the postmortem
  RUNBOOK_UPDATE: updating the runbook
</task>

<transcript_to_summarise>

{"id": "sum5", "role": "summary", "body": "R1-5 released; R5 inspected. Next: record R5 notes, advance through R10, then submit the final answer.
- Log format: "<ISO ts> LEVEL service msg", e.g. "WARN auth-svc db pool exhausted wait_ms=N in_use=X/X", "ERROR <svc> upstream returned N upstream=fx-rates retry_after_...". Noise lines: slow query ms=N table=orders|items|events, plus heartbeat, health ok, gc cycle and request ok.
- R1: noise only. round-01/changes.md:3 CHG-108 PROPOSED (HPA max for search), not applied.
- R2 board.md:3-5 opened ALERT_TUNING, RUNBOOK_UPDATE and VENDOR_TICKET.
- R2 changes.md:4 CHG-120 APPLIED: build 8.56.0 to notify-worker, sets http.max_inflight=0. This could become a BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT, but notify-worker shows no errors through R5. R2 changes.md:5 CHG-121 (payments) has no config change.
- R2 auth-svc.log has pool exhaustion at lines 1,3,15,22,23,25,44,65,69.

Thread A: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED, affecting auth-svc and search-api.
- Opened ongoing at round-03/board.md:3.
- Evidence: round-03/logs/auth-svc.log:7-19, round-03/logs/search-api.log:1-14, round-04/logs/auth-svc.log:7-39 (12 hits), round-04/logs/search-api.log:4-30 (12 hits).
- round-05/board.md:3 set status to mitigated (errors reduced; monitoring).
- round-05/changes.md:4 CHG-143 APPLIED: mitigation for thread A deployed to auth-svc.
- R5 logs show no pool exhaustion in auth-svc or search-api.
- R3 changes.md:3 CHG-125 APPLIED was dashboards only.

Thread B: board says CACHE_STAMPEDE, but logs point to UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT. Affects payments-svc and checkout-api.
- round-04/board.md:3 opened it for payments-svc as CACHE_STAMPEDE suspected, ongoing.
- round-05/board.md:4 added checkout-api; cause and status unchanged.
- The logs show only 429s from fx-rates, with no cache errors. Watch whether the board revises the cause to UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT.
- payments-svc 429s: round-04/logs/payments-svc.log lines 1,3,7,25,31,45 (12 hits); round-05/logs/payments-svc.log lines 13,19,47,50,55,73 (6 hits).
- checkout-api 429s: round-04/logs/checkout-api.log lines 9,19,50,53,59,62; round-05/logs/checkout-api.log lines 21,23,30,38,42,59 (7 hits).

Other change records:
- round-04/changes.md:3 CHG-133 APPLIED: TLS session ticket rotation hourly.
- round-05/changes.md:3 CHG-138 APPLIED: same TLS rotation change. Not cert expiry; watch for CERT_EXPIRED anyway.

Follow-ups:
- Open: ALERT_TUNING, RUNBOOK_UPDATE, VENDOR_TICKET (R2), CAPACITY_REVIEW (round-05/board.md:5).
- None closed so far.

Notes are kept in /task/workspace/notes.md (R4 appended; R5 not yet).

Open questions:
- Will Thread B's cause be corrected?
- Will Thread A be resolved?
- Will CHG-120 max_inflight=0 cause a notify-worker incident?
- Will any false-alarm threads appear?"}

code:

print('ok')"}
